noise_coordinate_change.name: noise coordinate change (SD6 -> SI1000)
noise_coordinate_change.kind: coordinate change, not a component substitution
noise_coordinate_change.note: H3 confirmed on the real artifact: the noise coordinate is baked into the circuit, so changing it is NOT circuit-preserving -- while substituting the noise *component* (an equal-valued ErrorModel built by a different call path) is.

inadmissible_pair.name: H1: BB + cardinal is inadmissible
inadmissible_pair.message: Error: strategy='cardinal' is not supported for BbCode. Supported strategies: custom, zxcoloration.
inadmissible_pair.semantic_message: contract violated: extractor (strategy 'cardinal' is not on BB's whitelist ['custom', 'zxcoloration'])

arch_family_restriction.name: arch = grid2d on a non-BB family
arch_family_restriction.note: a second hidden cross-component dependency of exactly the H1 shape: whether a layout can be used is a property of the code component, checked by QUITS at run time and by the semantic layer's arch contract before assembly

non_c4_substitution.name: decoder value swap (BP-OSD -> BP-LSD)
non_c4_substitution.kind: a substitution that is NOT pointwise equal on R(x)
non_c4_substitution.note: the checker's job is to refuse here, and it does: (C4) fails, so no 'cone 外不变' claim is made
